events.account: same generator: hub-issued u_ + 12 hex for everyone
events.action: deliberate signal: the hub's route category (gap 4)
events.body: deliberate signal: request bodies (checked by the bag-of-words test)
events.chain: same generator: hub-issued chain ID or null when anonymous
events.endpoint: deliberate signal: the hub's route name
events.headers: same generator: the shared emulator sends none
events.host: deliberate signal: the link host the client used (markers come back)
events.http_fp: same generator: deterministic function of client family, method, auth, language
events.key_id: same generator: last 8 characters of a hub-issued key
events.key_state: deliberate signal: the hub's verdict on the key (current, grace, reused, ...)
events.markers_served: deliberate signal: the canary markers the hub served
events.method: deliberate signal: what the client did (shared emulator sets it the same way)
events.origin_asn: same generator: one shuffled range of private ASNs
events.origin_class: same generator: the 4.1 confusion matrix for everyone, swarm included
events.origin_net: same generator: one shuffled pool of synthetic /24 IDs (origin-model 10)
events.probes_served: deliberate signal: the probe families the hub served
events.req: same generator: the hub's request counter
events.rtt_gap_ms: same generator: one gap model per path type; null for HTTP/3
events.seq: same generator: the hub's global row counter
events.session: same generator: the key chain (kc_ + 10 hex) or a hub cookie (ck_ + 12 hex)
events.signed_agent: deliberate signal: Web Bot Auth signature (agent page fetchers only)
events.t: same generator: simulated time, continuous for every population, rounded to ms by the hub
events.tls_fp: same generator: the client stack's fingerprint (shared table)
events.ts: same generator: the hub's ISO rendering of t
